title: Floating Static Routes and Administrative Distance
summary: Configure and verify primary and floating static routes with deliberate administrative distance separation, validating real-time link failover and preemption.
learning_objectives: Explain the role of Administrative Distance (AD) in Cisco IOS routing table installation and path selection
Configure a primary static default route with default administrative distance (AD 1) across a primary WAN link
Configure a floating static default route with elevated administrative distance (AD 5) across a secondary backup link
Configure bidirectional return static routes and floating backup routes on an upstream provider gateway
Verify that the floating backup route remains dormant in the routing table while the primary link remains operational
Demonstrate dynamic route failover and path divergence via traceroute when the primary link is administratively disabled
Demonstrate automatic preemption and routing table convergence when the primary WAN link is restored

source.origin: Independently authored enterprise floating static route curriculum guide aligned with Cisco CCNA exam topic 3.4
